query:
WITH Graduates2021_2025 AS (
  SELECT id, graduation_date, major_name, major_classification_parent_name
  FROM estishraf_llm_university_graduates_impala
  WHERE YEAR(graduation_date) BETWEEN 2021 AND 2025
  AND qualification IN ('بكالوريوس', 'ماجستير', 'دكتوراه', 'زمالة')
  AND graduation_date IS NOT NULL
),
AllGraduatesByMajor AS (
  SELECT major_name, COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS total_graduates
  FROM Graduates2021_2025
  GROUP BY major_name
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT id) >= 10
),
EmployedGraduatesByMajor AS (
  SELECT g.major_name, COUNT(DISTINCT g.id) AS employed_count
  FROM Graduates2021_2025 g
  INNER JOIN estishraf_llm_jobs_info_v3_impala j ON g.id = j.id
  WHERE j.job_start_date >= g.graduation_date 
    AND j.job_start_date <= DATE_ADD(g.graduation_date, 365)
  GROUP BY g.major_name
),
EmploymentRates AS (
  SELECT 
    a.major_name,
    a.total_graduates,
    COALESCE(e.employed_count, 0) AS employed_count,
    ROUND(COALESCE(e.employed_count, 0) * 100.0 / a.total_graduates, 2) AS employment_rate
  FROM AllGraduatesByMajor a
  LEFT JOIN EmployedGraduatesByMajor e ON a.major_name = e.major_name
),
LowEmploymentMajors AS (
  SELECT major_name, employment_rate
  FROM EmploymentRates
  WHERE employment_rate < 50
),
MilitaryRanks AS (
  SELECT 'رقيب' AS rank_job UNION ALL SELECT 'نقيب' UNION ALL 
  SELECT 'جندي اول' UNION ALL SELECT 'رقيب اول' UNION ALL 
  SELECT 'جندي' UNION ALL SELECT 'عريف' UNION ALL 
  SELECT 'ملازم' UNION ALL SELECT 'ملازم اول' UNION ALL 
  SELECT 'عقيد' UNION ALL SELECT 'عميد' UNION ALL SELECT 'لواء'
),
LowEmploymentGraduatesJobs AS (
  SELECT j.job_title, COUNT(*) AS job_count
  FROM Graduates2021_2025 g
  INNER JOIN LowEmploymentMajors l ON g.major_name = l.major_name
  INNER JOIN estishraf_llm_jobs_info_v3_impala j ON g.id = j.id
  WHERE j.job_title IS NOT NULL 
    AND j.job_title NOT IN ('لا ينطبق', 'غير معروف')
    AND j.job_title NOT IN (SELECT rank_job FROM MilitaryRanks)
  GROUP BY j.job_title
)
SELECT job_title, job_count
FROM LowEmploymentGraduatesJobs
ORDER BY job_count DESC
LIMIT 10
